name: Flora AI — Node-Based AI Workflow Launch
description:
A cinematic product launch template built around a node-based AI creative workflow. Designed natively in Raylight with smooth camera tracking, glassmorphic UI cards, and dynamic canvas zoom-outs.

What’s inside the timeline:
• Prompt & Agentic Flow: Typing prompt bar, kinetic typography, and automated workflow status tags.
• AI Model Selector: Interactive dial transition switching between image and video generation models.
• Node Canvas & Bezier Connections: Connected media nodes with glowing path animations, image-to-image reference updates, and voiceover selection UI.
• Export & Multi-Format Grid: Resolution toggles (740p, 1080p, 4K), before/after polish preview, full node-tree zoom-out, and minimal logo reveal.

Fully layered and customizable—swap in your own UI assets, media outputs, prompts, and brand colors in minutes. #Awards
